name: Push-up
cues: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower your chest to just above the floor.
Press up without sagging your hips.

name: Incline push-up
cues: Hands on a sturdy bench or counter, body straight.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the edge.
Push back up, keeping your core tight.

name: Wide push-up
cues: Place hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower with elbows flaring slightly out.
Drive the floor away to finish.

name: Close-grip push-up
cues: Hands close together under your chest.
Keep elbows tucked against your ribs as you lower.
Press up fully without letting the hips drop.

name: Feet-elevated push-up
cues: Rest your feet on a step or sofa, hands on the floor.
Keep a rigid line from head to heels.
Lower slowly and press back up.

name: Single-arm push-up
cues: Feet wide for balance, one hand behind your back.
Keep your hips square to the floor.
Lower under control and press up.

name: Chest squeeze
cues: Press your palms together in front of your chest.
Push hard and hold the tension.
Keep shoulders down and breathe steadily.

name: Superman
cues: Lie face down with arms reaching forward.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few inches together.
Hold, looking at the floor to keep your neck long.

name: Bodyweight squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart, chest up.
Sit your hips back and down until thighs are near parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.

name: Glute bridge
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Single-leg glute bridge
cues: Extend one leg straight, other foot planted.
Lift your hips level without twisting.
Lower with control and switch sides.

name: Walking lunge
cues: Take a long step forward and drop your back knee.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push off and step through to the next lunge.

name: Split squat
cues: Stand in a long stride with feet staying planted.
Lower straight down, torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.

name: Jump squat
cues: Squat down, then explode upward.
Land softly on bent knees.
Reset your stance before the next rep.

name: Standing long jump
cues: Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump forward as far as you can.
Absorb the landing with soft knees, then reset.

name: Side-lying leg raise
cues: Lie on your side with hips stacked.
Lift the top leg without rolling backward.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching.

name: Rear leg raise
cues: Stand tall holding a wall for balance.
Lift one leg straight behind you.
Squeeze your glute and lower with control.

name: Quadruped glute kickback
cues: Start on hands and knees, back flat.
Press one foot up toward the ceiling.
Stop before your lower back arches.

name: Wall sit
cues: Back flat against a wall, thighs level with the floor.
Knees stacked over ankles.
Hold and breathe while your legs burn.

name: Calf raise
cues: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Plank
cues: Forearms under shoulders, body in a straight line.
Brace your belly and squeeze your glutes.
Keep breathing; do not let your hips sag.

name: Crunch
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl your shoulders off the floor using your abs.
Lower slowly without yanking your neck.

name: Sit-up
cues: Feet flat, arms crossed or by your ears.
Roll up to sitting in one smooth motion.
Lower back down with control.

name: Dead bug
cues: Lie on your back, arms up, knees over hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down, then switch.

name: Reverse crunch
cues: Lie back with knees pulled toward your chest.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your ribs.
Lower slowly, no swinging.

name: Flutter kicks
cues: Lie back with legs straight and hovering.
Kick small, quick alternating beats.
Press your lower back into the floor.

name: Russian twist
cues: Sit leaning back with your chest tall.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Lift your feet for more challenge.

name: Side plank
cues: Stack feet, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is one line.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Air bike
cues: Hands by your ears, shoulders lifted.
Drive one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Pedal your legs in a steady rhythm.

name: Alternating heel touch
cues: Lie with knees bent and shoulders slightly raised.
Reach one hand toward the same-side heel.
Alternate sides, keeping the motion small.

name: Oblique crunch
cues: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Curl your ribs toward your hip.
Lower slowly and finish all reps per side.

name: Scissor kick
cues: Lie back, legs lifted a few inches.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion.
Keep your lower back flat.

name: Jackknife sit-up
cues: Lie flat with arms overhead and legs straight.
Lift arms and legs to meet over your hips.
Lower with control and repeat.

name: Bird dog
cues: Start on hands and knees, back flat.
Reach the opposite arm and leg out long.
Pause, then return and switch sides.

name: Jumping jacks
cues: Jump feet wide as your arms swing overhead.
Jump back to standing with hands at your sides.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.

name: High knees
cues: Run in place driving your knees to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Stay tall and land softly.

name: Fast skipping
cues: Skip in place with quick, bouncy steps.
Swing opposite arm and knee together.
Keep it light and rhythmic.

name: Butt kicks
cues: Jog in place flicking heels toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs mostly vertical.
Stay upright and breathe evenly.

name: Carioca step
cues: Move sideways crossing one foot in front, then behind.
Rotate your hips as you travel.
Keep quick, light steps.

name: March in place
cues: Lift your knees at a steady pace.
Swing your arms naturally.
Raise the pace as you warm up.

name: Mountain climbers
cues: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive your knees toward your chest in turn.
Keep your hips low and level.

name: Star jump
cues: Crouch, then burst up with arms and legs wide.
Land softly and go straight into the next one.
Reach long at the top.

name: Scissor jump
cues: Jump and switch your legs front to back.
Land softly on both feet.
Keep your chest up.

name: Knee tuck jump
cues: Jump straight up and pull both knees in.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset your balance before the next one.

name: Burpee
cues: Squat and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back, then in again.
Stand and jump with hands overhead.

name: Inchworm
cues: Fold forward and walk your hands out to a plank.
Pause with a flat back.
Walk your hands back to your feet and stand.

name: Spider crawl
cues: Crawl forward in a low plank position.
Bring each knee toward the same-side elbow.
Keep your hips low.

name: Child's pose
cues: Kneel and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms long in front of you.
Breathe slowly into your back.

name: Cat stretch
cues: On hands and knees, round your spine up.
Tuck your chin and pelvis.
Move slowly with your breathing.

name: Hamstring stretch
cues: Sit with one leg straight, the other bent.
Hinge forward from your hips.
Hold at a gentle pull, then switch.

name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
cues: Kneel in a lunge, back knee down.
Tuck your pelvis and shift forward gently.
Feel the stretch at the front of your back hip.

name: Standing calf stretch
cues: Hands on a wall, one leg stepped back.
Press the back heel into the floor.
Lean in until you feel your calf stretch.

name: Triceps stretch
cues: Raise one arm and bend the elbow behind your head.
Use the other hand to ease the elbow back.
Keep your ribs down; switch sides.

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
cues: Bring one arm across your chest.
Hug it close with your other hand.
Keep your shoulder relaxed; switch sides.

name: Knees to chest
cues: Lie on your back and hug your knees in.
Let your lower back relax into the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold.

name: Lying spinal twist
cues: Lie back and drop one bent knee across your body.
Keep both shoulders on the floor.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Side neck stretch
cues: Sit or stand tall, ear toward your shoulder.
Keep the opposite shoulder pressed down.
Hold gently, never forcing it; switch sides.

name: World's greatest stretch
cues: Step into a deep lunge with both hands inside the front foot.
Rotate your chest and reach one arm to the sky.
Return and switch sides.

name: Arm circles
cues: Arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Draw big smooth circles, then reverse.
Keep your neck relaxed.
